description: FSRS ROUTER: the single most-urgent concept to REINFORCE now (mastered earlier but whose recall is decaying), plus every due target in priority order. With session_id it unions session and cross-lesson profile memory; learner_id works without a live session. Returns reinforcement (the first of due, else of relearn, else of unmeasured), due, relearn (graded weak), unmeasured (self-rated only), counts {due, relearn, unmeasured, total}, reason (due|nothing_due|no_history: due when any of the three lists is not empty), and next_due_at. `now_ms` (epoch ms) is injectable for deterministic review scheduling; defaults to the session's clock with session_id, else the server clock.

now_ms.description: epoch ms, for deterministic scheduling: the session started with it stamps its answers, ratings and reviews there; defaults to the server clock

name: get_next_reinforcement
